profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a technical support leader with over 20+ years of experience in middleware technologies with excellent technical and management skills. Detail oriented, technical support leader known for increasing operational efficiency and building new teams. Highly regarded for creating best work culture, analytical thinker, problem solver and easy to work with.  

** Core Strengths **
Team leadership/ Management
Team building
Problem solving and troubleshooting
Project management
Process improvement
Customer service
Mentoring and training
Application programming
Web development

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Primary duties:
●	Lead worldwide HCL portal L2 product support teams in 5 countries providing enterprise support to over 2000+ customers worldwide
●	Create, manage, and oversee processes for smoother operations of WW HCL DX software while maintaining Net Promoter Score of 80+
●	Prepare and present monthly/quarterly business review to executives, geo managers, test, services, product development, sales, and offering/product management providing operations insight and decide future direction of the software product.
●	Escalation management and conflict resolution 

Additional responsibilities:
●	Coach, mentor, and train engineers enabling them for technical support
●	Provide advanced technical support, debugging and troubleshooting
●	Author, review and publish technical documents as subject matter expert
●	International assignment to train new support team
●	Interface with geo managers, test, services, product development, sales, and offering/product management providing future direction of the software product

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer III
positions.description:
●	Provided advanced technical support, debugging, and troubleshooting
●	Helped create IBM WebSphere Content Management developer certification exam
●	Interface with, test, services, product development, sales, and offering/product management providing future direction of the software product 
●	Reviewed and published 400+ technical documents improving customer self help
●	Created product bootcamp/education material and mentored and trained new team members 
●	Worked on a virtualization project that had a direct impact on time to resolution

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Provided technical support, debugging, and troubleshooting
●	Advanced troubleshooting of JAVA hang/crash/high cpu/memory/performance issues
●	Mastered troubleshooting search related issues. Crawler/ indexer/ Spider
●	Subject Matter expert in troubleshooting WebSphere content Management issues
●	Assisted technical growth by writing 300+ technical documents and blog posts
●	Collaborated with test, L3, development, sales for successful and timely problem resolution
